title: Lost updates from an unsynchronized counter
root_cause: balance += 1 is really three steps: read, add one, write back. When 8 threads do this concurrently with no lock, two threads can read the same value and both write back the same result, silently losing one increment.
defenses: Protect shared mutable state with a mutex, or use atomics for simple counters.
Prefer immutable data and message-passing between threads where possible.
Run ThreadSanitizer (-fsanitize=thread) in testing -- it reports the exact racing accesses.
Document and review the locking order for every piece of shared state to avoid deadlock too.
